seo.title: Carrera Real del Potosí 2026: Date, Distances, Fee & Race Kit
seo.description: Guide to the Carrera Real del Potosí 2026 (5th edition): a night race on Saturday, October 17 at 7:00 p.m. in Parque Tangamanga I. 3K, 6K and 10K, $375 MXN online registration, kit with a light-up wristband and medal.

hero.subtitle: 3K, 6K and 10K under the lights of Parque Tangamanga I
hero.description: The fifth Carrera Real del Potosí runs at night. Start and finish are on Av. Artesanos, in front of the planetarium, and the kit includes a light-up wristband and a medal.

items.label: Start & finish
items.value: Av. Artesanos, in front of the planetarium, Parque Tangamanga I

kit.title: What's in the race kit
kit.sizes: Shirt sizes from XS to 3XL–6XL; you pick yours when you register.

registration.title: Registration
registration.description: Online only, on the Tu Tiempo a Tiempo timing platform. Choose your distance and size, then pay $375 MXN.
registration.policy: Entries are personal, non-transferable and non-refundable. If the event is cancelled by the authorities or force majeure, the organizers will announce the options.

items.title: Be visible
items.description: Wear the kit's light-up wristband and light-colored or reflective clothing.

items.title: Arrive before sunset
items.description: Finding the planetarium and the start is easier in daylight.

items.title: Layer up for after
items.description: October evenings cool down quickly; bring a sweatshirt for the finish.

items.title: Altitude
items.description: San Luis Potosí sits around 1,860 m. If you're coming from sea level, start easy.

items.q: When is the Carrera Real del Potosí 2026?
items.a: Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 7:00 p.m. It's the fifth edition and it's run at night.
In Parque Tangamanga I, on Av. Artesanos in front of the planetarium. The finish is in the same spot.

items.q: How much is it and what distances are there?
items.a: $375 MXN for any of the three distances: 3 km, 6 km or 10 km.
Online at tutiempoatiempo.com: pick your distance and shirt size and pay. Entries are personal, non-transferable and non-refundable.
A shirt, medal, bib, timing chip, light-up wristband and a surprise gift.
